name: 本文と動画を共有する会話投稿
prompt:
Generate one faithful, high-resolution mobile UI screenshot of the existing Japanese Lighthouse community post shown in the native preview. Keep the canvas aspect ratio exactly 390:446, with no outer frame, browser chrome, extra controls, or surrounding page. Treat the native preview as the authority for the layout, visible Japanese content, proportions, and Lighthouse palette. Treat the original Discord screenshot as the authority for the embedded YouTube artwork, crop, and hyperlink semantics. Use the prior LH03-0151 v003 only as a reference for the user-requested hyperlink blue; do not copy its layout or approximate artwork.

Reproduce the preview's complete single post: pale mint avatar with the same simple glyph, author 「山田 はるか」 at upper left and 「07:14」 at upper right; body text exactly 「みんなで相談した内容に近い動画です。」; then the clickable text 「共有した動画を開く」 in clear hyperlink blue (#007AFF). Below it, keep the compact shared-video card aligned at the same left inset, with its narrow forest-green vertical rule and pale mint surface. Inside the card preserve provider text 「動画の共有」 in gray, video title 「地域の活動を伝える工夫」 in hyperlink blue, and linked category line 「発信のアイデア・交流・地域の活動」 in hyperlink blue. Keep the same Meiryo-like Japanese text roles, weight hierarchy, line spacing, and compact alignment as the native preview.

Preserve the embedded video thumbnail's exact source scene and crop from the original screenshot: centered vertical video, dark top/bottom bands, phone/Tesla scene, red annotation marks, visible play circle, and original small English thumbnail text. Do not invent or substitute the thumbnail. Keep the thumbnail's proportions and position from the native preview. Keep all non-link body and author text dark, the provider label gray, and only the three hyperlink text roles blue. No decorative shadows, new labels, extra logos, new emoji, or rewritten Japanese.

settings.inspection: stored image opened and visually compared

reviewNotes: 第1版を目視。投稿者名・時刻・本文・青い共有リンク・共有動画カード・青タイトル/カテゴリ・灰色providerを維持。ネイティブ比で上部テキストとカード開始が約7〜10px下方へずれ、カード高さと余白にも小差。元画像のTesla/iPhone縦動画・再生円・赤注記は認識可能だが、小さな英字と実画像細部の厳密一致は未達。needs-correctionで保持。所有者受入・ネイティブ編集・動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: Native Lighthouse preview: exact post layout, Japanese copy, geometry and color roles
Primary Discord source screenshot: original YouTube thumbnail and hyperlink treatment; component crop [12,253,378,691] in normalized-width-390 coordinates
LH03-0151 v003 color reference only: user-requested blue video title/category; not layout or artwork authority
